chains.title: TCF7L2-bound 8q24 enhancer represses POU5F1B; alt T loses repression and raises CRC risk

links.claim: TCF7L2 is occupied over the variant in HCT116 and is highly expressed (E05), making it a leading candidate; however, there is no QBiC-SELEX model or allele-specific occupancy assay for TCF7L2 here, so the ref-G > alt-T binding direction is assumed, not measured. E04 shows many other expressed TFs also bound, so occupancy alone does not uniquely select TCF7L2.
rs6983267 lies in the ENSR8_CGMBX enhancer and in pELS EH38E3858447, which has DNase and H3K27ac signal consistent with an active enhancer.

The variant-bearing enhancer is assigned to POU5F1B: POU5F1B is 78.9 kb away/in the gene body, has the best L2G score (0.89), and shows a significant colon eQTL in which alt T increases POU5F1B expression (NES +0.20).
The mechanism is relevant to colorectal cells: TCF7L2 is occupied at the variant in HCT116, the element is a pELS, and the POU5F1B eQTL evidence comes from colon tissue.

The top CRC association in E15 uses effect allele T, and alt T increases POU5F1B in colon (E17/E20), while POU5F1B has been reported to promote CRC growth/metastasis (E18d). But allele direction is heterogeneous across CRC/colon traits in E15 and POU5F1B is not a common essential in bowel lines (E21), so the phenotype step is plausible but weak.

predictions: TCF7L2 ChIP/EMSA at rs6983267 shows stronger binding on ref G than alt T in colorectal cells.
TCF7L2 knockdown or CRISPRi increases POU5F1B expression, consistent with repression.
The alt T allele associates with higher POU5F1B expression in colon tissue.
The rs6983267 element physically contacts the POU5F1B promoter or gene body in colorectal cells.
falsified_if: TCF7L2 occupancy is not allele-specific at rs6983267 or is stronger on alt T rather than ref G.
TCF7L2 loss decreases or does not change POU5F1B expression rather than increasing it.
The element does not contact POU5F1B in colorectal cells.

chains.title: SP1 binds the alt T allele and activates POU5F1B

links.claim: SP1 is occupied over the variant in HCT116 and expressed there (E06), but no QBiC-SELEX model or allele-specific assay is provided; alt-T > ref-G SP1 binding is inferred from the alt-T POU5F1B eQTL and is not measured. E04 shows other bound TFs, so this TF choice is not uniquely supported.
The variant lies in an active pELS enhancer, EH38E3858447, within the ENSR8_CGMBX enhancer, with DNase and H3K27ac signal.
The enhancer is linked to POU5F1B by proximity/gene-body location, best L2G score 0.89, and a colon eQTL in which alt T increases POU5F1B.
SP1 is occupied at the variant in HCT116 and the POU5F1B eQTL is from colon tissue, supporting relevance to colorectal cells.

Alt T is the strongest CRC effect allele in E15, increases POU5F1B in colon, and POU5F1B has been reported to promote CRC. However, allele direction is heterogeneous across E15 CRC/colon entries and POU5F1B is not a common essential in bowel lines (E21), so the phenotype link is weak.

predictions: SP1 ChIP/EMSA at rs6983267 shows stronger binding on alt T than ref G.
SP1 knockdown reduces POU5F1B expression in colorectal cells.
The alt T allele increases POU5F1B expression in colon tissue.

chains.title: YY1 binds the ref G allele and represses POU5F1B; alt T loses repression

links.claim: YY1 is occupied over the variant in HCT116 and is highly expressed (E07), but no QBiC-SELEX model or allele-specific assay is provided; ref-G > alt-T YY1 binding and a repressive role are assumptions. E04 shows many other bound TFs.
The variant lies in the active pELS EH38E3858447 within the ENSR8_CGMBX enhancer.
POU5F1B is the best-supported target by proximity/gene-body location, L2G 0.89, and the colon eQTL showing alt T increases POU5F1B.
YY1 is occupied at the variant in HCT116 and the target eQTL is in colon tissue.

If ref-G-bound YY1 represses POU5F1B, alt T would derepress POU5F1B; alt T is the strongest CRC effect allele in E15 and POU5F1B has been reported to promote CRC. But the repressor role is unmeasured, E15 allele direction is heterogeneous, and POU5F1B is not a common essential in bowel lines (E21), so this phenotype link is weak.

predictions: YY1 ChIP/EMSA at rs6983267 shows stronger binding on ref G than alt T.
YY1 knockdown increases POU5F1B expression, consistent with repression.
The alt T allele has lower YY1 occupancy and higher POU5F1B expression in colon.
falsified_if: YY1 binding is not allele-specific at rs6983267.
YY1 loss decreases rather than increases POU5F1B.

We demonstrate that rs6651252 resides within a Wnt responsive DNA enhancer element (WRE) and that the disease associated allele augments binding of the TCF7L2 transcription factor to this region.
Using CRISPR/Cas9 directed gene editing and epigenetic modulation, we find that the rs6651252 enhancer regulates expression of the c-MYC proto-oncogene (MYC).
